newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's A.Dominguez trade opens, then readjusts.
newsitem.headline: Spain's A.Dominguez trade opens, then readjusts.

text.p: Shares in Spanish fashion house Adolfo Dominguez opened down 14.96 percent to 5,060 pesetas on Wednesday, and will now stop trade and restart another period of adjustment, a bourse spokesman said.
Trade was delayed from opening at 0900 GMT this morning due to a heavy order floor.
Trade opened with a volume of 138,254 shares, with the shares falling near to the 15 percent maximum fluctuation limit allowed.

The high number of small orders for the shares ran the risk of blocking trade in the rest of the bourse for technical reasons, market sources said. This meant the shares had to be returned to an adjustment period.

"We have carried out an allotment of shares in order to return to the adjustment period, and at the moment that there is substantial volume we'll make new assignations," said a bourse authority spokesman.
